description: Source code for a class that performs PEP-8 compliance testing on Python files within an Odoo module, including various code quality checks and result formatting.

classes.name: quality_test
classes.description: A class that extends base_module_quality.abstract_quality_check to perform PEP-8 style and code quality checks on Python files in a specified module directory.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the quality_test instance with default parameters and descriptive attributes.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Executes various code quality checks on Python files within a given module path, calculating a score based on PEP-8 compliance.

methods.name: check_import
methods.description: Checks that import statements are correctly placed and formatted in Python files.

methods.name: check_licence
methods.description: Verifies presence and position of copyright and license declarations in Python files.

methods.name: check_loop
methods.description: Detects usage of certain methods inside loops, which is discouraged for performance reasons.

methods.name: check_space
methods.description: Checks for improper spacing before punctuation characters in Python code.

methods.name: check_space_operator
methods.description: Checks for excessive spacing around operators, though this method is commented out in the main flow.

methods.name: check_len
methods.description: Ensures sequences are checked using their boolean value rather than length comparisons.

methods.name: check_boolean
methods.description: Detects comparisons of boolean values to True or False using == or !=, which is discouraged.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Formats the overall test result into a table for display.

methods.name: get_result_general
methods.description: Generates an HTML formatted detailed report of the code quality checks.
